metadata.scenario: A patient calls the clinic to schedule a follow-up appointment with the dermatologist next Friday. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret, how can I help you today? Hi Margaret, it's Charles Thompson. I wanted to schedule a follow-up appointment with the dermatologist for next Friday. Hi Charles! Great to hear from you. Let me check our schedule for next Friday. Can you confirm if you want a morning or afternoon appointment? Morning would be best, if possible. Alright, let me find an available slot for you. Just a moment, please. Sure, no problem. It looks like we have an opening at 10:30 AM next Friday. Does that work for you? Yes, that sounds perfect! Great! I'll go ahead and book that for you. Can I also confirm your phone number? Yes, it's +13165557890. Thank you, Charles. Your appointment is confirmed for next Friday at 10:30 AM. Is there anything else I can assist you with today? Actually, I’d like to know about my next wound care visit. Are there any updates? Yes, your last visit was two days ago. You’re due for another visit next Tuesday. Can I request a male nurse for that visit? Absolutely, I’ll note that preference for you. Thanks, I appreciate it. I also need a detailed progress report sent to the VA. No problem, we’ll prepare that for you. I’ll ensure it’s sent by the end of the week. Great! Is there anything else available, like therapy sessions? Yes, we offer physical therapy; it can really help with your recovery. What’s the pricing for that? Physical therapy sessions range from $110 to $140 per visit. I might consider that! Can I get more information later? Of course, I can have our Care Coordinator, Lisa, reach out to you. That would be helpful, thanks! You're welcome, Charles. I’ll make a note to have Lisa call you. Appreciate all your help today! Anytime! Thanks for calling, and have a wonderful day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
